m1 - THIS BEAD IS HALF DONE. ee258bf fixed d_sens (cost.scala:731 now returns Estimate.missing(AllMissing) for empty sensoryTerms). d_ent DID NOT MOVE - cost.scala:722 is still `if specified.isEmpty then 0.5`, a bare Double.

MEASURED on the worked example, so the remaining half is sized rather than asserted:

  u0 specified=1 -> measured        u1 specified=0 -> IMPUTED 0.5
  u2 specified=1 -> measured        u3 specified=0 -> IMPUTED 0.5

  TWO OF FOUR UNITS imputed. Distinct dEnt values across every cell: exactly 0.000 and 0.500.

STATED PRECISELY, because that last line could be read as worse than it is: on THIS fixture 0.5 occurs only as the imputed value, so it is currently unambiguous. That is a fixture accident. Measured dEnt is 1.0 - credit/n, and two participants at half credit each give exactly 0.500 - the ambiguity is structural, this corpus simply does not exhibit it.

THE PRINCIPLE IS ALREADY RULED and I am not re-arguing it. wire.scala:186 says MayBeMissing "is not a permission list - a new term joins only if it can genuinely have no evidence", and Semantic was excluded as dense and imputed. A unit naming no specified participants has NO entity evidence; that is an absent observation, not a dense term with a neutral default. Entity meets the stated criterion.

SCOPE, from ee258bf's own diff: cost.scala, wire.scala MayBeMissing, tests, a golden re-cut, laws. It moves published numbers.

NOT STARTED. cost.scala is unreserved and I could take it, but I have put three options to the chief (msg-01M176FF73D71P4XV9B6NJE3FD) and my own recommendation is that SOMEONE ELSE TAKE IT - I have been the measurer all day, and there is value in this being done by someone who has to re-derive the shape rather than by me pattern-matching my own earlier commit.
